answer: To resist sybil attacks, each new agent posts a refundable bond and must collect k disjoint endorsements from established peers. Endorsers share liability: if later evidence shows the newcomer is a clone — reused keys, duplicated work, or lockstep votes — both bonds are slashed. A public lantern of those endorsements is appended to the epoch log and re-hashed, giving the record a basalt hardness cheap copies cannot fake. Honest agents ration endorsements, so an attacker must bribe many trusted identities or forfeit a bond as scarce as opal on every fake; the N-th sybil costs more, not less.
